message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Your eagerness to prove yourselves as a long-term partner is exactly why we are writing with a clear proposal, and the place to prove it is quality.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

On energy costs:
German electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 36.75.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 37.08.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 37.31.

Option A is the package we can approve: it commits you to a quality level well below your current record, and it sets a unit price that fits the stable prices and the falling energy costs above.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Just before closing: what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. I can offer 46.50 EUR for this package, but we really need you to start paying on time.

Our proposal includes a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, we can offer a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
